title: Labor Day, Minus the Labor: DoorDash Unveils Its Top Burger and Hot Dog Spots for the Holiday Weekend
summary: From smashburgers to sizzling franks, DoorDash unveils its Top Burger and Hot Dog list to order in for Labor Day weekend
body_markdown:
Labor Day weekend is coming up on September 7, and DoorDash is marking the unofficial end of summer by serving up its **Top Burger and Hot Dog list*** on DoorDash. The list recognizes standout small and medium-sized restaurants making it easy to skip the grill and let someone else handle the holiday weekend cooking.


Whether the occasion calls for a smashburger stacked high, a chili-topped hot dog, or a footlong dressed the way your hometown does it, these local spots make it easy to celebrate Labor Day weekend on-demand. From a 90-year-old Virginia diner to a Chicago hot dog stand that's been slinging Vienna Beef since 1954, the list spans decades-old institutions and newer neighborhood favorites alike, including[Frankie's Hot Dogs](https://www.doordash.com/store/147965) in Connecticut;[Crown Burgers](https://www.doordash.com/store/130299) in Utah; and[Sup Dogs](https://www.doordash.com/store/541222) in North Carolina.


> *"Labor Day means one more cookout before summer’s over, but someone still has to handle the shopping, the prep, and the cleanup,” said* ***Ruth Isenstadt, Head of U.S. Restaurants at DoorDash.*** *“This list skips all of that. Order from these top burger and hot dog spots your neighborhood already loves, and get straight to eating.”*


### **Celebrating DoorDash's Top Burger and Hot Dog Spots**


Last year, DoorDash customers ordered** **100+ million burgers** and **28+ million hot dogs** , proof the classics remain a holiday-weekend staple.


Based on DoorDash data from August 2025 through July 2026, the list includes small and medium-sized restaurants that serve burgers and/or hot dogs, at least 1,000 lifetime reviews, fewer than 10 stores, and the highest average consumer ratings.
